M50|A58|L37|N100: B: trades at anchor - 50 ms, activation +58 ms, cancel latency 37 ms, fill notice +100 ms
S1lo|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the start of the admissible S1 window; contradictory events held at M50
S1mid|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the middle of the admissible S1 window; contradictory events held at M50
S1hi|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the end of the admissible S1 window; contradictory events held at M50
S2lo|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the start of the admissible S2 window; contradictory events held at M50
S2hi|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the end of the admissible S2 window; contradictory events held at M50
S3lo|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the start of the admissible S3 (semantics) window; contradictory events held at M50
S3hi|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the end of the admissible S3 (semantics) window; contradictory events held at M50
EVhi|A58|L37|N100: every trade at the the REST evidence cap (the latest admissible instant); contradictory events held at M50
M50|A25|L37|N100: the order goes live 25 ms after posting (B: 58)
M50|A100|L37|N100: the order goes live 100 ms after posting (B: 58)
M50|A58|L0|N100: every cancel takes effect 0 ms after its decision (B: 37)
M50|A58|L100|N100: every cancel takes effect 100 ms after its decision (B: 37)
M50|A58|L37|N0: the client learns of a full fill 0 ms after it (B: 100)
M50|A58|L37|N250: the client learns of a full fill 250 ms after it (B: 100)
M0|A58|L37|N100: every trade stamp 0 ms before its anchor (B: 50 ms) - a uniform clock offset, not an order latency
M250|A58|L37|N100: every trade stamp 250 ms before its anchor (B: 50 ms) - a uniform clock offset, not an order latency

timeline_rules.S1lo: start of the admissible S1 window
timeline_rules.S1mid: middle of the admissible S1 window
timeline_rules.S1hi: end of the admissible S1 window
timeline_rules.S2lo: start of the admissible S2 window
timeline_rules.S2hi: end of the admissible S2 window
timeline_rules.S3lo: start of the admissible S3 (semantics) window
timeline_rules.S3hi: end of the admissible S3 (semantics) window
timeline_rules.EVhi: the REST evidence cap (the latest admissible instant)
timeline_rules.held: an event without an admissible window keeps its M50 time
